name: Gasthaus-Appartement Wildauer
beschreibung: The Gasthaus-Appartement Wildauer in Ebbs is a traditionally run inn. The accommodation is located in the Tiroler Unterinntal, not far from the town of Kufstein. The surroundings are characterized by the foothills of the Kaisergebirges and are suitable for hiking and cycling tours. The inn offers both dining services and apartments with a separate living area. The apartments are equipped with a kitchenette and basic furnishings. Free Wi-Fi and parking spaces are available to guests. The house is in a quiet location and yet well connected to the transport network. Guests often use the accommodation as a base for activities in the region.
